RagShortTexts: The political system of the Western Empire was militarized, and the emperor was the supreme military commander.

Variants.Content: In a country with a highly militarized political system, the local military chief is also the local chief executive. The legion system after the Kalad Empire abolished the standing army was followed, but since its territory was only 1/3 of the original empire, the emperor was the ruler of the empire and the supreme commander of the military.

The empire’s military promotion system follows the promotion system of the Kalad Empire, and it also follows this system, which will never allow lower-level civilians to climb to the core of our aristocratic class. As each level goes up, the accumulated military merits need to be higher. Unless they kill everyone on the entire continent, they will not be able to accumulate the title of real power. Respecting soldiers is a common method used by the elders of noble families, but if necessary, soldiers are victims who can be consumed at will, and their lives are not valuable. As for the people? In the eyes of the lords, they might just be gray animals used as production tools. In fact, the power of the Western Empire is still vigorously competed by several imperial families. Especially those lords with poor reputations who were excluded by the Northern Senate and were not accepted by the Southern Empire.

The power of the Western Empire came entirely from the support of the army. From the beginning, there was almost no promotion mechanism with any secular bias, attracting a large number of capable people. But are there people among these capable people who hope to become emperors? No one wants to have fewer rights, which means that becoming the emperor of this empire must have strong military capabilities that deter other lords of the empire. If not, then the emperor of the empire will most likely change hands. After all, the Kalad Empire's "Senate" legal system and lineage are not recognized here. The power of the army is the only order. When the free promotion mechanism comes, it is a free order, and even violence is one of the tacitly allowed freedoms.
